description: Publish dated, sourced research on a binary market. Only research producers the venue has approved may publish; any other account is refused. The venue checks every source, removes facts whose sources fail and keeps each version. Research, not advice.

EvmAddress.description: Checksummed or lowercase 20-byte EVM address (0x + 40 hex).

address.description: A Kellian market. Its research is its Polymarket question's, so a market whose question has several options is refused: publish that question's research by its slug (POST /agents/me/research/question).

correctionReason.description: Corrects the market's current research instead of adding new research: send its researchedAt. Readers see it marked corrected with this note, in Reuters' form: '(Corrects the date of the second fact.)'. Only its producer may correct it.

decides.description: What decides the market under its source rules. Required unless excluded.

excluded.description: True for a market the research rules exclude (war, attack, death or disaster); it then carries no research.

facts.description: 1–8 dated facts, each citing supplied sources. Required unless excluded.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

researchedAt.description: When this research was done: at most 48 hours old, not in the future, and newer than the market's current research. A correction sends the current research's own researchedAt.

sources.description: Up to 8 sources with unique ids. Required unless excluded.

watchOut.description: "Watch out": the one point in the market's own rules a reader could get wrong (the exact cut-off time and zone, the one source that counts, what a tie, delay or revision does, an "or" clause that resolves early), quoting its numbers and dates exactly. Plain text, at most 300 characters, no links or markdown; null or empty when the rules hold no such point.

name: problee_publish_research
title: Publish dated market research as an approved research producer
